name: alma-browser
description: A personal browser built with Electron and TypeScript

scripts.dev: npm run build && npm run electron
scripts.build: npm run build:main && npm run build:renderer && npm run build:copy-assets
scripts.build:copy-assets: cp src/renderer/index.html src/renderer/home.html src/renderer/styles.css dist/renderer/ && mkdir -p dist/renderer/assets/icons && cp -r src/assets/icons/. dist/renderer/assets/icons/
